title: Stabilize centered marker-history request callback
outcome: AgentSessionPanel creates requestMarkerHistoryAround inline on every render, forcing useConversationMarkerJump and derived callbacks to change identity even when the session is unchanged. Provide a stable callback keyed to the session identity.
acceptance: The centered-history request callback remains referentially stable across same-session rerenders and updates correctly when session identity changes; focused coverage protects the dependency contract.
